note: Written on 2026-11-13 by the people who built the tool, who by then knew how the Swarm Traces incident unfolded: which actions were harmful, in what order, and when. On that incident (and on the wiki swarm, whose pack was written on it) the timing of these signs is hindsight, not a test. The forward test uses data they were not written on.

signs.name: Cloud metadata first requested
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'cloud_metadata', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: Docker registry first used
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'docker_registry', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: First Hugging Face dataset write
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'hf_dataset_write', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: Kubernetes API first called
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'kubernetes_api', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: Kubernetes service-account token first read
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'kubernetes_token', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: Registry mailbox first used
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'registry_board', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: First page hidden
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'hides_page', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: First probe request
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'probe_request', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: First proxy link
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'proxy_link', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.name: Page recreated after a delete
signs.definition: The first record that does what the pack calls 'recreated_after_delete', a harmful action of one actor. Known when that record is seen.

signs.id: spread: first use of an item seen earlier
signs.name: Token seen as data, then used
signs.definition: A token appears inside a record as data before any record uses it to authenticate; known when it is first used.

signs.id: coordination: two identities use one place
signs.name: Two identities share one place
signs.definition: Two different identities name the same shared place (board, dataset) in different records.

signs.id: coordination: one identity carries another's token
signs.name: One identity carries another's token
signs.definition: A record that authenticates as one identity holds another identity's token before that token's own first use.

signs.name: First message between named actors
signs.definition: An actor reads, from an exact (not coarse) place, what a different named actor wrote there earlier.

signs.name: A group of 3+ actors linked by messages
signs.definition: Messages join actors into one connected group of at least k.

signs.name: A group of 5+ actors linked by messages
signs.definition: Messages join actors into one connected group of at least k.

signs.name: A group of 10+ actors linked by messages
signs.definition: Messages join actors into one connected group of at least k.

signs.name: A group of 20+ actors linked by messages
signs.definition: Messages join actors into one connected group of at least k.

signs.name: First two-way exchange
signs.definition: Two named actors have each now sent a message to the other.

signs.name: First program reused by another actor
signs.definition: The same program (text with ids, numbers and hashes masked) is run by a second named actor; routine programs (no shared place, nothing harmful) are ignored.

signs.name: First program run by three actors
signs.definition: A third named actor runs a program already run by two; routine programs are ignored.

signs.name: Volume alarm on all actions
signs.definition: The first hour whose count of actions exceeds the mean plus 3 standard deviations of every earlier hour (at least 12 earlier hours; standard deviation at least 1). Known at the end of that hour.

signs.name: Volume alarm on harmful actions
signs.definition: The same rule applied to the count of harmful actions per hour.

rules.name: Volume baseline: ordinary volume alarm
rules.description: a sign of baseline, any kind

forward_test.rule: seeds 21-30 were not run before this file was written
